newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SAYS NO BIDS AT REVERSE REPO TENDER.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SAYS NO BIDS AT REVERSE REPO TENDER.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Tuesday said it had failed to attract any bids at this morning's securities reverse repurchase tender.

"The tender failed because the banks' liquidity is still below the minimum required level, though banks and the NBS anticipate a liquidity inflow," Peter Andresic, head of the NBS Open Market Operations Department, told Reuters.
